verses.1:5: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.1:6: Now the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.1:7: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, Kittim and Dodanim.
verses.1:8: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.1:9: And the sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. Now the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.1:10: And Cush fathered Nimrod; he began to be mighty on the earth.
verses.1:17: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
verses.1:28: And the sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.1:29: And these are their generations. The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.1:31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah: these are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.1:32: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine, whom she bore: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Now the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan: Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.1:33: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were sons of Keturah.
verses.1:34: And Abraham fathered Isaac, whose sons were Esau and Israel.
verses.1:35: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.1:36: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
verses.1:37: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.1:38: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.1:39: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. And Lotan's sister was Timna.
verses.1:40: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. The sons of Anah: Dishon.
verses.1:41: The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.1:42: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.1:43: These are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom before there was a king over the sons of Israel: Bela son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.1:44: Then Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
verses.1:45: And when Jobab had also died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.1:46: Husham also died, and in his place reigned Hadad son of Bedad, who struck down Midian in the land of Moab; and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.1:47: And when Hadad had also died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.1:48: And Samlah also died, and in his place reigned Shaul from Rehoboth, which is situated beside the river.
verses.1:49: When Shaul also died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.1:50: And he also died, and Hadad reigned in his place; the name of his city was Pau, and his wife was called Mehetabel, daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.
verses.1:51: And when Hadad died, there began to be chiefs in place of kings in Edom: Chief Timna, Chief Alvah, Chief Jetheth,
verses.1:52: Chief Oholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,
verses.1:53: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,
verses.1:54: Chief Magdiel, and Chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
verses.2:1: Now the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
verses.2:2: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.2:3: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah; these three were born to him by the daughter of Shua, a Canaanite woman. Now Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil before the Lord, and He put him to death.
verses.2:4: And Tamar, his daughter-in-law, bore him Perez and Zerah. So all the sons of Judah were five.
verses.2:5: Now the sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
verses.2:6: The sons of Zerah also: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol as well, and Dara, five in all.
verses.2:7: The sons of Carmi: Achar, who troubled Israel and sinned in the theft of the devoted thing.
verses.2:9: Now the sons of Hezron who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.2:10: And Ram fathered Amminadab. Now Amminadab fathered Nahshon, leader of the sons of Judah.
verses.2:11: Nahshon also fathered Salma, from whom Boaz was born.
verses.2:12: And Boaz fathered Obed, who himself also fathered Jesse.
verses.2:13: Now Jesse fathered the firstborn Eliab, the second Abinadab, the third Shimea,
verses.2:14: the fourth Nethanel, the fifth Raddai,
verses.2:15: the sixth Ozem, the seventh David.
verses.2:16: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.2:17: And Abigail bore Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.2:18: Now Caleb, the son of Hezron, took a wife named Azubah, by whom he fathered Jerioth; and her sons were Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.2:19: And when Azubah had died, Caleb took Ephrathah as a wife, who bore him Hur.
verses.2:20: And Hur fathered Uri, and Uri fathered Bezalel.
verses.2:21: After these things Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead, and he took her when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
verses.2:22: And Segub also fathered Jair, and he possessed twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.2:23: And Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair, and Kenath and its villages, sixty cities; all these were the sons of Machir, the father of Gilead.
verses.2:24: Now when Hezron had died, Caleb went in to Ephrathah. Hezron also had a wife Abijah, who bore him Ashhur, the father of Tekoa.
verses.2:25: Now the sons born to Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, were Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Aram, Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.2:26: Jerahmeel also married another wife, named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam.
verses.2:27: Moreover, the sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
verses.2:28: Now Onam had sons, Shammai and Jada. And the sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
verses.2:29: And the name of Abishur's wife was Abihail, who bore him Ahban and Molid.
verses.2:30: And the sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim. But Seled died without children.
verses.2:31: And the son of Appaim was Ishi, and this Ishi fathered Sheshan. And Sheshan fathered Ahlai.
verses.2:32: And the sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. And Jether also died without children.
verses.2:33: And Jonathan fathered Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.2:34: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters; and he had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
verses.2:35: And he gave him his daughter as a wife, and she bore him Attai.
verses.2:36: And Attai fathered Nathan, and Nathan fathered Zabad.
verses.2:37: Zabad also fathered Ephlal, and Ephlal fathered Obed.
verses.2:38: Obed fathered Jehu, Jehu fathered Azariah,
verses.2:39: Azariah fathered Helez, and Helez fathered Eleasah.
verses.2:40: Eleasah fathered Sismai, Sismai fathered Shallum,
verses.2:41: Shallum fathered Jekamiah, and Jekamiah fathered Elishama.
verses.2:42: Now the sons of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn; he is the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah, the father of Hebron.
verses.2:43: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
verses.2:44: And Shema fathered Raham, the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem fathered Shammai.
verses.2:45: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
verses.2:46: Now Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez. And Haran fathered Gazez.
verses.2:47: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.2:48: Caleb's concubine Maacah bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
verses.2:49: And Shaaph, the father of Madmannah, fathered Sheva, the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.2:50: These were the sons of Caleb, the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim;
verses.2:51: Salma, the father of Bethlehem; Hareph, the father of Beth-gader.
verses.2:52: Now there were sons of Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim, who saw half of the resting places.
verses.2:53: And from the family of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. From these came out the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
verses.2:54: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, the crowns of the house of Joab, and half of the resting place of the Zorites;
verses.2:55: also the families of the scribes living in Jabez, singing and resounding, and dwelling in tents. These are the Kenites, who came from the heat of the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.3:1: Now David had these sons, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelitess;
verses.3:2: the third, Absalom, the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah, the son of Haggith;
verses.3:3: the fifth, Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah his wife.
verses.3:4: Six, therefore, were born to him in Hebron, where he reigned for seven years and six months. And he reigned for thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
verses.3:5: Moreover, in Jerusalem sons were born to him: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four by Bathsheba the daughter of Ammiel;
verses.3:7: and Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.3:8: as well as Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.3:9: All these were sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and they had a sister, Tamar.
verses.3:10: Now the son of Solomon was Rehoboam, whose son Abijah fathered Asa. From him also was born Jehoshaphat,
verses.3:11: the father of Joram; this Joram fathered Ahaziah, from whom Joash sprang;
verses.3:12: and his son Amaziah fathered Azariah. Moreover, Azariah's son Jotham
verses.3:13: fathered Ahaz, the father of Hezekiah, from whom Manasseh was born.
verses.3:14: And Manasseh also fathered Amon, the father of Josiah.
verses.3:15: Now the sons of Josiah were: the firstborn, Johanan; the second, Jehoiakim; the third, Zedekiah; the fourth, Shallum.
verses.3:16: From Jehoiakim were born Jeconiah and Zedekiah.
verses.3:17: The sons of Jeconiah were Assir, Shealtiel,
verses.3:18: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Sama, and Nedabiah.
verses.3:19: From Pedaiah sprang Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel fathered Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister;
verses.3:20: also Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed, five.
verses.3:21: Now the son of Hananiah was Pelatiah, the father of Jeshaiah, whose son was Rephaiah; his son also was Arnan, from whom Obadiah was born, whose son was Shecaniah.
verses.3:22: The son of Shecaniah was Shemaiah, whose sons were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six in number.
verses.3:23: The son of Neariah: Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.3:24: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.4:1: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
verses.4:2: Now Reaiah the son of Shobal fathered Jahath, from whom were born Ahumai and Lahad; these are the clans of the Zorathites.
verses.4:3: This also is the lineage of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. And the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
verses.4:4: And Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.4:5: Now Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.4:6: And Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These are the sons of Naarah.
verses.4:7: Moreover, the sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
verses.4:8: And Koz fathered Anub, Zobebah, and the clan of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.4:9: Now Jabez was renowned above his brothers, and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, "Because I bore him in pain."
verses.4:10: And Jabez called upon the God of Israel, saying, "If in blessing You bless me, and expand my borders, and Your hand is with me, and You cause me not to be oppressed by evil." And God granted what he prayed for.
verses.4:11: Now Caleb the brother of Shuhah fathered Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
verses.4:12: Moreover, Eshton fathered Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah, the father of the city of Nahash; these are the men of Recah.
verses.4:13: Now the sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah. Moreover, the sons of Othniel were Hathath and Meonothai.
verses.4:14: Meonothai fathered Ophrah, and Seraiah fathered Joab, the father of the Valley of Craftsmen, for craftsmen were there.
verses.4:15: Now the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh were Ir, Elah, and Naam. And the sons of Elah: Kenaz.
verses.4:16: And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
verses.4:17: And the sons of Ezrah were Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and he fathered Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah, the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.4:18: And his wife Judaia bore Jered, the father of Gedor, and Heber, the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel, the father of Zanoah. Now these were the sons of Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
verses.4:19: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham the father of Keilah, were Garmi and Eshtemoa, who was from Maacath.
verses.4:20: And the sons of Shimon were Amnon, and Rinnah the son of Hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
verses.4:21: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er, the father of Lecah, and Laadah, the father of Mareshah, and the clans of the house of those who work fine linen in the house of the oath.
verses.4:22: And he who made the sun stand still, and the men of Falsehood, and Secure, and Burning, who were princes in Moab, and who returned to Lahem; now these are ancient words.
verses.4:23: These are the potters living in plantations and in hedges, with the king in his works; and they remained there.
verses.4:24: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul;
verses.4:25: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.4:26: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.4:27: The sons of Shimei were sixteen, and his daughters six; but his brothers did not have many sons, and the entire clan could not equal the total of the sons of Judah.
verses.4:28: Now they lived in Beersheba, Moladah, and Hazar-shual,
verses.4:29: and in Bilhah, and in Ezem, and in Tolad,
verses.4:30: and in Bethuel, and in Hormah, and in Ziklag,
verses.4:31: and in Beth-marcaboth, and in Hazar-susim, and in Beth-biri, and in Shaaraim; these were their cities until King David.
verses.4:32: Their villages also were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities.
verses.4:33: And all their hamlets around these cities as far as Baal; this is their dwelling place and the distribution of their settlements.
verses.4:34: Meshobab also, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.4:35: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.4:36: and Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
verses.4:37: and Ziza also, the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah.
verses.4:38: These are those named as leaders in their clans, and in the house of their kindred they multiplied greatly.
verses.4:39: And they set out to enter Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, and to seek pastures for their flocks.
verses.4:40: And they found rich and very good pastures, and a very broad, quiet, and fertile land, in which some from the lineage of Ham had lived before.
verses.4:41: These, therefore, whom we recorded above by name, came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the inhabitants who had been found there, and destroyed them until the present day; and they lived in their place, because they found very rich pastures in that very place.
verses.4:42: From the sons of Simeon also, five hundred men departed to Mount Seir, having as leaders Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi;
verses.4:43: and they struck the remnant of the Amalekites who had been able to escape, and lived there in their place until this day.
verses.5:1: Also, the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel. (For he himself was his firstborn, but when he had violated his father's bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel, and he was not reckoned as the firstborn.
verses.5:2: Moreover, as for Judah, who was the strongest among his brothers, from his stock leaders sprang forth, yet the birthright was reckoned to Joseph.)
verses.5:3: Therefore, the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.
verses.5:4: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.5:5: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
verses.5:6: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser, king of the Assyrians, led captive; and he was a leader in the tribe of Reuben.
verses.5:7: And his brothers and his entire clan, when they were numbered by their families, had Jeiel and Zechariah as leaders.
verses.5:8: Now Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, he himself lived in Aroer as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.
verses.5:9: Toward the eastern region also he lived as far as the entrance of the wilderness and the river Euphrates. For they possessed a great number of livestock in the land of Gilead.
verses.5:10: Now in the days of Saul they fought against the Hagrites and killed them, and lived in their place in their tents, in the entire region that looks toward the east of Gilead.
verses.5:11: And the sons of Gad lived opposite them in the land of Bashan as far as Salecah:
verses.5:12: Joel at the head, and Shapham second; and Janai and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.5:13: And their brothers, according to the houses of their clans: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.
verses.5:14: These are the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.
verses.5:15: Also the brothers, the sons of Abdiel, the son of Guni, leader of the house in their families.
verses.5:16: And they lived in Gilead, and in Bashan and in its villages, and in all the outskirts of Sharon, as far as the borders.
verses.5:17: All these were numbered in the days of Jotham, king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam, king of Israel.
verses.5:18: The sons of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, fighting men, bearing shields and swords, drawing the bow, and trained for battles, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty, going out to combat.
verses.5:19: They fought against the Hagrites; now the Itureans, Naphish, and Nodab
verses.5:20: gave them aid. And the Hagrites were handed over into their hands, and all who had been with them, because they called upon God while they were fighting; and He heard them, because they had believed in Him.
verses.5:21: And they captured all that they had possessed: fifty thousand camels, and two hundred fifty thousand sheep, and two thousand donkeys, and one hundred thousand human souls.
verses.5:22: And many fell wounded, for it was the Lord's war. And they lived in their place until the exile.
verses.5:23: Also, the sons of the half-tribe of Manasseh possessed the land from the borders of Bashan as far as Baal, Hermon, and Senir, and Mount Hermon; for the number was immense.
verses.5:24: And these were the leaders of the house of their clan: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, very strong and powerful men, and renowned chiefs in their families.
verses.5:25: But they abandoned the God of their fathers and committed fornication after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God removed before them.
verses.5:26: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul, king of the Assyrians, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser, king of Assyria; and he carried away Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Lahela, and to Habor, Hara, and the river Gozan, to this day.
verses.5:27: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.5:28: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.5:29: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.5:30: Eleazar fathered Phinehas, and Phinehas fathered Abishua.
verses.5:31: And Abishua fathered Bukki, and Bukki fathered Uzzi.
verses.5:32: Uzzi fathered Zerahiah, and Zerahiah fathered Meraioth.
verses.5:33: Now Meraioth fathered Amariah, and Amariah fathered Ahitub.
verses.5:34: Ahitub fathered Zadok, and Zadok fathered Ahimaaz,
verses.5:35: Ahimaaz fathered Azariah, Azariah fathered Johanan,
verses.5:36: Johanan fathered Azariah; he is the one who served in the priesthood in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
verses.5:37: And Azariah fathered Amariah, and Amariah fathered Ahitub,
verses.5:38: Ahitub fathered Zadok, and Zadok fathered Shallum,
verses.5:39: Shallum fathered Hilkiah, and Hilkiah fathered Azariah,
verses.5:40: Azariah fathered Seraiah, and Seraiah fathered Jehozadak.
verses.5:41: Now Jehozadak went out when the Lord carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hands of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.6:1: The sons of Levi, therefore, were Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.6:2: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
verses.6:3: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.6:4: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. Now these are the clans of Levi according to their families.
verses.6:5: Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.6:6: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.
verses.6:7: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.6:8: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
verses.6:9: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, Shaul his son.
verses.6:10: The sons of Elkanah were Amasai and Ahimoth
verses.6:11: and Elkanah. The sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
verses.6:12: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.6:13: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn Vashni, and Abijah.
verses.6:14: Now the sons of Merari: Mahli; Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
verses.6:15: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.6:16: These are those whom David appointed over the singers of the house of the Lord, from the time the ark was set in place.
verses.6:17: And they served before the tabernacle of the testimony, singing until Solomon built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem; moreover, they stood in service according to their order.
verses.6:18: Now these are the ones who stood in attendance with their sons: of the sons of Kohath, Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
verses.6:19: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Tohu,
verses.6:20: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.6:21: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.6:22: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.6:23: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.6:24: And his brother Asaph, who stood at his right hand, Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.6:25: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
verses.6:26: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.6:27: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.6:28: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.6:29: And the sons of Merari, their brothers, on the left: Ethan the son of Cushi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.6:30: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.6:31: the son of Amasai, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
verses.6:32: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.6:33: Also their brothers the Levites, who were assigned to the entire service of the tabernacle of the house of the Lord.
verses.6:34: Now Aaron and his sons burned incense on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the Holy of Holies, and to pray for Israel according to everything that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.6:35: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.6:36: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.6:37: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.6:38: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.6:39: And these are their dwelling places throughout the villages and borders, namely, of the sons of Aaron, according to the clans of the Kohathites; for they had fallen to them by lot.
verses.6:40: Therefore they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and its outskirts all around;
verses.6:41: but the fields of the city and the villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.6:42: Moreover, to the sons of Aaron they gave cities of refuge: Hebron, and Libnah, and its outskirts,
verses.6:43: Jattir also, and Eshtemoa with their outskirts, as well as Hilen, and Debir with their outskirts,
verses.6:44: Ashan also, and Beth-shemesh, and their outskirts.
verses.6:45: And from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba and its outskirts, and Alemeth with its outskirts, Anathoth also with its outskirts; all the cities were thirteen, by their clans.
verses.6:46: Now to the remaining sons of Kohath from their clan, they gave from the half-tribe of Manasseh ten cities as a possession.
verses.6:47: Moreover, to the sons of Gershom by their clans, from the tribe of Issachar, and from the tribe of Asher, and from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.6:48: And to the sons of Merari by their clans, from the tribe of Reuben, and from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun, they gave twelve cities by lot.
verses.6:49: The sons of Israel also gave the Levites the cities and their outskirts.
verses.6:50: And they gave by lot, from the tribe of the sons of Judah, and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon, and from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, these cities which they called by their names,
verses.6:51: and to those who were of the clan of the sons of Kohath; and there were cities within their borders from the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.6:52: Therefore they gave them cities of refuge: Shechem with its outskirts in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer with its outskirts,
verses.6:53: Jokmeam also with its outskirts, and Beth-horon likewise,
verses.6:54: and also Helon with its outskirts, and Gath-rimmon in the same manner.
verses.6:55: Furthermore, from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner and its outskirts, Bileam and its outskirts; that is, for those who remained of the clan of the sons of Kohath.
verses.6:56: Now to the sons of Gershom, from the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and its outskirts, and Ashtaroth with its outskirts.
verses.6:57: From the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh and its outskirts, and Daberath with its outskirts,
verses.6:58: Ramoth also and its outskirts, and Anem with its outskirts.
verses.6:59: And from the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its outskirts, and Abdon likewise,
verses.6:60: Hukok also and its outskirts, and Rehob with its outskirts.
verses.6:61: Moreover, from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee and its outskirts, Hammon with its outskirts, and Kiriathaim and its outskirts.
verses.6:62: Now to the remaining sons of Merari: from the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono and its outskirts, and Tabor with its outskirts;
verses.6:63: and across the Jordan also, opposite Jericho, to the east of the Jordan, from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its outskirts, and Jahzah with its outskirts,
verses.6:64: Kedemoth also and its outskirts, and Mephaath with its outskirts.
verses.6:65: And also from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead and its outskirts, and Mahanaim with its outskirts,
verses.6:66: as well as Heshbon with its outskirts, and Jazer with its outskirts.
verses.7:1: Now the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.7:2: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Samuel, chiefs by the houses of their clans. From the lineage of Tola, very valiant men were numbered in the days of David: twenty-two thousand six hundred.
verses.7:3: The sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah, from whom were born Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five, all of them chiefs.
verses.7:4: And with them, by their families and peoples, equipped for battle, were very valiant men, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
verses.7:5: Their brothers also, throughout the entire clan of Issachar, very strong for fighting, were numbered: eighty-seven thousand.
verses.7:6: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.7:7: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five chiefs of families and very strong for fighting; and their number was twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.
verses.7:8: Now the sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jerimoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth; all these were the sons of Becher.
verses.7:9: And they were numbered by their families, chiefs of their clans, very valiant for wars: twenty thousand and two hundred.
verses.7:10: Now the sons of Jediael: Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.7:11: All these were the sons of Jediael, chiefs of their clans, very valiant men, seventeen thousand and two hundred going out to battle.
verses.7:12: Shuppim also and Huppim were the sons of Ir; and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
verses.7:13: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.7:14: Now the son of Manasseh was Asriel; and his Syrian concubine bore Machir, the father of Gilead.
verses.7:15: And Machir took wives for his sons Huppim and Shuppim, and he had a sister named Maacah; and the name of the second was Zelophehad, and daughters were born to Zelophehad.
verses.7:16: And Maacah, the wife of Machir, bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; moreover, the name of his brother was Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.7:17: And the son of Ulam was Bedan. These are the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.7:18: And his sister Queen bore Handsome Man, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.7:19: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.7:20: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son, his son Zabad,
verses.7:21: and his son Shuthelah, and his son Ezer and Elead; and the native men of Gath killed them, because they had gone down to seize their possessions.
verses.7:22: Therefore Ephraim their father mourned for many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
verses.7:23: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and she called his name Beriah, because he had been born in the misfortunes of his house.
verses.7:24: And his daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth-horon, and Uzzen-sheerah.
verses.7:25: Now his son was Rephah, and Resheph, and Telah, from whom Tahan was born,
verses.7:26: who fathered Ladan; his son also was Ammihud, who fathered Elishama,
verses.7:27: from whom Nun was born, who had a son, Joshua.
verses.7:28: And their possession and dwelling were Bethel with its daughters, and toward the east Naaran, toward the western region Gezer and its daughters, Shechem also with its daughters, as far as Aza with its daughters.
verses.7:29: And alongside the sons of Manasseh were Beth-shean and its daughters, Taanach and its daughters, Megiddo and its daughters, and Dor and its daughters; in these the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel, lived.
verses.7:30: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.7:31: And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel; he is the father of Birzaith.
verses.7:32: And Heber fathered Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.7:33: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Chamaal, and Ashvath; these were the sons of Japhlet.
verses.7:34: Now the sons of Shomer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
verses.7:35: And the sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.7:36: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
verses.7:37: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
verses.7:38: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara.
verses.7:39: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
verses.7:40: All these were the sons of Asher, chiefs of the clans, chosen and very valiant commanders of commanders; and the number of those of an age that was fit for war was twenty-six thousand.
verses.8:1: Now Benjamin fathered Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
verses.8:2: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.8:3: And the sons of Bela were Addar, Gera, and Abihud;
verses.8:5: as well as Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.8:6: These are the sons of Ehud, leaders of the clans living in Geba, who were carried away to Manahath.
verses.8:7: Now Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera—he himself carried them away, and he fathered Uzza and Ahihud.
verses.8:8: Now Shaharaim became a father in the region of Moab, after he sent away Hushim and Baara, his wives.
verses.8:9: And by Hodesh his wife he fathered Jobab, Zibia, Mosa, and Malcam,
verses.8:10: also Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah: these are his sons, leaders in their families.
verses.8:11: And Mehusim fathered Abitub and Elpaal.
verses.8:12: Now the sons of Elpaal were Eber, Misham, and Shemed; he built Ono and Lod, and its daughters.
verses.8:13: And Beriah and Shema were leaders of the clans living in Aijalon; these put to flight the inhabitants of Gath.
verses.8:16: also Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.
verses.8:18: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal;
verses.8:21: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
verses.8:25: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.
verses.8:27: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
verses.8:28: These were the patriarchs and leaders of the clans, who lived in Jerusalem.
verses.8:29: Now in Gibeon lived Abigabaon, and the name of his wife was Maacah;
verses.8:30: and his firstborn son was Abdon, and Zur, Kish, Baal, and Nadab;
verses.8:31: also Gedor, Ahio, Zecher, and Mikloth.
verses.8:32: And Mikloth fathered Shimeah; and they lived opposite their brothers in Jerusalem with their brothers.
verses.8:33: Now Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul. And Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.8:34: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal fathered Micah.
verses.8:35: The sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.8:36: And Ahaz fathered Jehoaddah, and Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza,
verses.8:37: and Moza fathered Binea, whose son was Raphah, from whom Eleasah was born, who fathered Azel.
verses.8:38: Now Azel had six sons, with these names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.8:39: And the sons of Eshek his brother were Ulam the firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.8:40: And the sons of Ulam were very strong men, drawing the bow with great strength, and having many sons and grandsons, up to one hundred fifty. All these were the sons of Benjamin.
verses.9:1: Therefore all Israel was counted, and their total was written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and they were carried away to Babylon because of their transgression.
verses.9:2: Now the first ones who lived in their possessions and in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.
verses.9:3: In Jerusalem resided some of the sons of Judah, and of the sons of Benjamin, and also of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh.
verses.9:4: Uthai son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, of the sons of Perez son of Judah.
verses.9:5: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
verses.9:6: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
verses.9:7: Furthermore, of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hassenuah,
verses.9:8: and Ibneiah son of Jeroham, and Elah son of Uzzi, son of Michri, and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah,
verses.9:9: and their brothers according to their families, nine hundred fifty-six. All these were chiefs of clans according to their fathers' houses.
verses.9:10: Now of the priests: Jedaiah, Joiarib, and Jachin;
verses.9:11: also Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, the chief priest of the house of God.
verses.9:12: Furthermore, Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah; and Maasai son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer.
verses.9:13: Also their brothers, chiefs according to their families, one thousand seven hundred sixty, very mighty in strength for doing the work of the service in the house of God.
verses.9:14: Now of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari.
verses.9:15: Also Bakbakkar the carpenter, and Galal, and Mattaniah son of Micah, son of Zichri, son of Asaph;
verses.9:16: and Obadiah son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who lived in the courts of the Netophathites.
verses.9:17: Now the gatekeepers were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brother Shallum was the chief;
verses.9:18: until that time, at the king's gate on the east, they of the sons of Levi kept watch in their turns.
verses.9:19: And Shallum son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah, with his brothers and his father's house: these are the Korahites over the works of the service, keepers of the vestibules of the tabernacle; and their families, in the turns of the camp of the Lord, were guarding the entrance.
verses.9:20: Now Phinehas son of Eleazar was their leader before the Lord.
verses.9:21: Furthermore, Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the gate of the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.9:22: All these chosen as doorkeepers at the gates were two hundred twelve, and they were registered in their own villages, whom David and Samuel the seer appointed in their faithfulness,
verses.9:23: both them and their sons, at the doors of the house of the Lord and in the tabernacle, in their turns.
verses.9:24: Along the four winds were the doorkeepers: that is, to the east, and to the west, and to the north, and to the south.
verses.9:25: Now their brothers stayed in small villages, and they came on their sabbaths from time to time.
verses.9:26: To these four Levites was entrusted the entire number of the gatekeepers, and they were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of the Lord.
verses.9:27: Also around the temple of the Lord they stayed in their watches, so that when the time came, they themselves would open the doors in the morning.
verses.9:28: Some of their lineage were also over the vessels of the service, for by count the vessels were both brought in and carried out.
verses.9:29: Some of them also, who had the utensils of the sanctuary entrusted to them, were in charge of the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.9:30: Now the sons of the priests prepared the ointments from the spices.
verses.9:31: And Mattithiah the Levite, the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, was set over the things that were fried in the pan.
verses.9:32: Furthermore, some of the sons of Kohath, their brothers, were over the loaves of presentation, so that they would always prepare new ones on each sabbath.
verses.9:33: These are the chiefs of the singers according to the families of the Levites, who stayed in the chambers so that day and night they might continually attend to their service.
verses.9:34: The heads of the Levites, chiefs according to their families, remained in Jerusalem.
verses.9:35: Now in Gibeon resided the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, and the name of his wife was Maacah.
verses.9:36: His firstborn son was Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.9:37: also Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.9:38: Furthermore, Mikloth fathered Shimeam; these lived opposite their brothers in Jerusalem with their brothers.
verses.9:39: Now Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.9:40: Now the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal, and Merib-baal fathered Micah.
verses.9:41: Furthermore, the sons of Micah were Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.9:42: Now Ahaz fathered Jarah, and Jarah fathered Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri. And Zimri fathered Moza.
verses.9:43: And Moza fathered Binea, whose son Rephaiah fathered Eleasah, from whom Azel was born.
verses.9:44: Furthermore, Azel had six sons, by these names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, Hanan; these are the sons of Azel.
verses.10:1: Now the Philistines were fighting against Israel, and the men of Israel fled from the Philistines and fell wounded on Mount Gilboa.
verses.10:2: And when the Philistines had drawn near, pursuing Saul and his sons, they struck down Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
verses.10:3: And the battle grew heavy against Saul, and the archers found him and wounded him with arrows.
verses.10:4: And Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Unsheathe your sword and kill me, so that these uncircumcised men may not come and mock me." But his armor-bearer was unwilling to do this, terrified with fear; therefore Saul seized the sword and threw himself upon it.
verses.10:5: And when his armor-bearer saw this, namely, that Saul was dead, he also threw himself upon his sword and died.
verses.10:6: Therefore Saul perished, and his three sons, and all his house fell together.
verses.10:7: And when the men of Israel who lived in the plains saw this, they fled; and with Saul and his sons dead, they abandoned their cities and were scattered here and there; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
verses.10:8: On the next day, therefore, while the Philistines were stripping the spoils of those killed, they found Saul and his sons lying on Mount Gilboa.
verses.10:9: And when they had despoiled him, and cut off his head, and stripped him of his armor, they sent it into their land so that it might be carried around and shown to the temples of the idols and to the peoples;
verses.10:10: and they consecrated his armor in the shrine of their god, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.10:11: When the men of Jabesh-gilead heard this, namely, all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.10:12: every one of the valiant men rose up and took the corpses of Saul and of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak that was in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.10:13: Therefore Saul died because of his iniquities, because he transgressed the command of the Lord which He had commanded and did not keep it, and moreover even consulted a female medium,
verses.10:14: and did not hope in the Lord; because of which He killed him and transferred his kingdom to David son of Jesse.
verses.11:1: Therefore all Israel gathered to David in Hebron, saying, "We are your bone and your flesh.
verses.11:2: In former days also, while Saul was still reigning, you were the one who led out and brought in Israel; for the Lord your God said to you, 'You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be leader over them.'"
verses.11:3: Therefore all the elders of Israel came to the king in Hebron, and David entered into a covenant with them before the Lord; and they anointed him king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord that He spoke by the hand of Samuel.
verses.11:4: David and all Israel also went to Jerusalem; this is Jebus, where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.11:5: And those who inhabited Jebus said to David, "You will not enter here." Yet David captured the citadel of Zion, which is the city of David.
verses.11:6: And he said, "Whoever strikes a Jebusite first will be leader and commander." Therefore Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became leader.
verses.11:7: Now David lived in the citadel, and for that reason it was called the city of David.
verses.11:8: And he built the city all around, from Millo as far as the surrounding circuit; Joab, however, built up the rest of the city.
verses.11:9: And David kept advancing, going on and growing, and the Lord of hosts was with him.
verses.11:10: These are the leaders of David's mighty men, who helped him so that he would become king over all Israel, according to the word of the Lord that He spoke to Israel.
verses.11:11: And this is the number of David's strong men: Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, leader among the thirty; he lifted his spear over three hundred wounded men at one time.
verses.11:12: And after him was Eleazar the son of his uncle, the Ahohite, who was among the three powerful men.
verses.11:13: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gathered to that place for battle; and a field of that region was full of barley, and the people had fled from before the Philistines.
verses.11:14: They stood in the middle of the field and defended it; and when they had struck down the Philistines, the Lord gave a great deliverance to His people.
verses.11:15: Now three of the thirty leaders went down to the rock where David was, to the cave of Adullam, when the Philistines had encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.11:16: Meanwhile David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem.
verses.11:17: Then David had a longing and said, "Oh, if only someone would give me water from the cistern of Bethlehem that is at the gate!"
verses.11:18: So those three went through the middle of the camp of the Philistines and drew water from the cistern of Bethlehem that was at the gate, and brought it to David so that he might drink. But he was unwilling, and instead poured it out as a drink offering to the Lord,
verses.11:19: saying, "Far be it from me to do this in the sight of my God and drink the blood of these men, for at the risk of their lives they brought me water." And for this reason he was unwilling to drink. The three strongest men did these things.
verses.11:20: Abishai also, the brother of Joab, was himself leader of the three; and he lifted his spear against three hundred wounded men, and he was most renowned among the three,
verses.11:21: and distinguished among the second three, and their leader; yet he had not attained to the first three.
verses.11:22: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a very strong man who had accomplished many deeds, from Kabzeel: he struck down two Ariels of Moab, and he went down and killed a lion in the middle of a cistern in a time of snow.
verses.11:23: And he struck down an Egyptian man whose stature was five cubits, and he had a lance like a weavers' beam; so he went down to him with a staff, and snatched the spear that he was holding in his hand, and killed him with his own spear.
verses.11:24: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things; he was most renowned among the three strong men,
verses.11:25: first among the thirty, yet he had not attained to the three. And David set him at his ear.
verses.11:26: Now the mightiest men in the army were Asahel the brother of Joab, and Elhanan the son of his uncle, from Bethlehem,
verses.11:27: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pharonite,
verses.11:28: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
verses.11:29: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.11:30: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.11:31: Ithai the son of Ribai from Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.11:32: Hurai from the brook of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite.
verses.11:34: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,
verses.11:35: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite,
verses.11:36: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.11:37: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.11:38: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
verses.11:39: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor-bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.11:40: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.11:41: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.11:42: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, leader of the Reubenites, and with him thirty;
verses.11:43: Hanan the son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.11:44: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
verses.11:45: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Thosaite,
verses.11:46: Eliel the Mahumite, and Jeribai and Josaia the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite, Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel from Masobia.
verses.12:1: These also came to David at Ziklag while he was still fleeing from Saul the son of Kish; they were very mighty and distinguished fighters,
verses.12:2: drawing the bow, and with either hand hurling stones from slings and shooting arrows, from the brothers of Saul, of Benjamin.
verses.12:3: The chief was Ahiezer, and Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Beracah, and Jehu the Anathothite.
verses.12:4: Also Shemaiah the Gibeonite, the mightiest among the thirty and over the thirty. Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite.
verses.12:6: And Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite.
verses.12:7: Elkanah, and Isshiah, and Azarel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam of the Korahites;
verses.12:8: Joelah also, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.12:9: Moreover, some from the Gadites also defected to David while he was hiding in the wilderness, very strong men and the finest fighters, holding shield and spear; their faces were like the face of a lion, and they were swift like gazelles on the mountains:
verses.12:10: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.12:11: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.12:12: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.12:13: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.12:14: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.
verses.12:15: These from the sons of Gad were leaders of the army: the least was over a hundred soldiers, and the greatest over a thousand.
verses.12:16: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it is accustomed to flood over its banks; and they put to flight all who were living in the valleys toward the eastern region and the western.
verses.12:17: Now some also came from Benjamin and from Judah to the stronghold in which David was staying.
verses.12:18: And David went out to meet them and said, "If you have come peacefully to me to help me, let my heart be joined to you; but if you are plotting against me on behalf of my adversaries, although I have no iniquity in my hands, may the God of our fathers see and judge."
verses.12:19: Then the Spirit clothed Amasai, chief among the thirty, and he said, "We are yours, David, and with you, son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, for your God helps you." Therefore David received them and appointed them leaders of the troop.
verses.12:20: Moreover, some from Manasseh defected to David when he was coming with the Philistines against Saul to fight; yet he did not fight with them, because after taking counsel, the leaders of the Philistines sent him back, saying, "At the peril of our heads he will return to his master Saul."
verses.12:21: Therefore, when he returned to Ziklag, there defected to him from Manasseh Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Adnah, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillethai, leaders of thousands in Manasseh.
verses.12:22: These gave help to David against the raiders, for they were all very mighty men, and they became leaders in the army.
verses.12:23: Moreover, day by day men were coming to David to help him, until there came to be a great number, like an army of God.
verses.12:24: This also is the number of the leaders of the army who came to David when he was in Hebron, to transfer the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.12:25: The sons of Judah carrying shield and spear: six thousand eight hundred, ready for battle.
verses.12:26: Of the sons of Simeon, very mighty men for fighting: seven thousand one hundred.
verses.12:27: Of the sons of Levi: four thousand six hundred.
verses.12:28: Jehoiada also, leader of the lineage of Aaron, and with him three thousand seven hundred.
verses.12:29: Zadok also, a young man of distinguished character, and the house of his father: twenty-two leaders.
verses.12:30: And of the sons of Benjamin, the brothers of Saul: three thousand; for a great part of them was still following the house of Saul.
verses.12:31: Furthermore, of the sons of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, very mighty in strength, renowned men in their clans.
verses.12:32: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, each individually by their names, came to appoint David king.
verses.12:33: Of the sons of Issachar also, learned men who knew each of the times so as to direct what Israel ought to do: two hundred leaders; and all the rest of the tribe followed their counsel.
verses.12:34: Moreover, of Zebulun, those who went out to battle and stood in battle array equipped with weapons of war: fifty thousand came to help, not with a double heart.
verses.12:35: And of Naphtali: one thousand leaders, and with them, equipped with shield and spear, thirty-seven thousand.
verses.12:36: Of Dan also, prepared for battle: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
verses.12:37: And of Asher, going out to fight and challenging in battle array: forty thousand.
verses.12:38: And across the Jordan, of the sons of Reuben, and of Gad, and of the half part of the tribe of Manasseh, equipped with weapons of war: one hundred twenty thousand.
verses.12:39: All these men of war, ready to fight, came with a perfect heart to Hebron to appoint David king over all Israel; and indeed all the rest of Israel were of one heart, that David should become king.
verses.12:40: And they were there with David for three days, eating and drinking, for their brothers had made preparations for them.
verses.12:41: Moreover, those who were near them, as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, were bringing loaves on donkeys, and camels, and mules, and oxen for eating: flour, fig cakes, raisins, wine, oil, oxen, and rams in full abundance; for indeed there was joy in Israel.
verses.13:1: Now David took counsel with the tribunes, and the centurions, and all the leaders,
verses.13:2: and he said to the whole assembly of Israel, "If it pleases you, and the word that I speak goes forth from the Lord our God, let us send to our remaining brothers in all the regions of Israel, and to the priests and Levites who live in the outskirts of the cities, that they may be gathered to us,
verses.13:3: and let us bring back the ark of our God to us, for we did not seek it in the days of Saul."
verses.13:4: And the entire multitude answered that it should be done so, for the word had pleased all the people.
verses.13:5: Therefore David gathered all Israel, from Shihor of Egypt until you enter Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
verses.13:6: And David went up, and every man of Israel, to the hill of Kiriath-jearim, which is in Judah, to bring from there the ark of the Lord God who sits above the cherubim, where His name was invoked.
verses.13:7: And they placed the ark of God upon a new cart from the house of Abinadab; and Uzzah and his brother were driving the cart.
verses.13:8: Now David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all strength in songs, and with lyres, and harps, and tambourines, and cymbals, and trumpets.
verses.13:9: Now when he had arrived at the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzzah stretched out his hand to steady the ark, for an unruly ox had tilted it a little.
verses.13:10: Therefore the Lord became angry against Uzzah and struck him because he had touched the ark; and he died there before the Lord.
verses.13:11: And David was grieved because the Lord had divided Uzzah; and he called that place Division of Uzzah, until the present day.
verses.13:12: And he feared God at that time, saying, "How can I bring the ark of God in to me?"
verses.13:13: And for this reason he did not bring it to himself, that is, into the city of David, but turned it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.13:14: Therefore the ark of God remained in the house of Obed-edom for three months; and the Lord blessed his house and all that he had.
verses.14:1: Hiram king of Tyre also sent messengers to David, and cedar timbers, and craftsmen of walls and of wood, to build him a house.
verses.14:2: And David knew that the Lord had confirmed him as king over Israel, and that his kingdom had been lifted up over His people Israel.
verses.14:3: David also took other wives in Jerusalem, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.14:4: And these are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.14:6: Nogah also, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.14:8: Now the Philistines, hearing that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all went up to seek him; and when David had heard this, he went out to meet them.
verses.14:9: Moreover, the Philistines came and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.14:10: And David consulted the Lord, saying, "Shall I go up against the Philistines, and will You deliver them into my hand?" And the Lord said to him, "Go up, and I will deliver them into your hand."
verses.14:11: And when they had gone up to Baal-perazim, David struck them there and said, "God has divided my enemies by my hand, just as waters are divided." And for that reason the name of that place was called Baal-perazim.
verses.14:12: And they abandoned their gods there, which David ordered to be burned up.
verses.14:13: On another occasion also, the Philistines rushed in and spread out in the valley.
verses.14:14: And David consulted God again, and God said to him, "Do not go up after them; withdraw from them, and you will come against them opposite the pear trees.
verses.14:15: And when you hear the sound of one marching in the tops of the pear trees, then you will go out to war, for God has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines."
verses.14:16: Therefore David did just as God had commanded him, and he struck the camp of the Philistines from Gibeon as far as Gezer.
verses.14:17: And the name of David was spread abroad in all the regions, and the Lord put the dread of him upon all the nations.
verses.15:1: He also made houses for himself in the city of David; and he built a place for the ark of God, and pitched a tent for it.
verses.15:2: Then David said, "It is unlawful for the ark of God to be carried by anyone except the Levites, whom the Lord chose to carry it and to minister to Him forever."
verses.15:3: And he gathered all Israel to Jerusalem so that the ark of God might be brought into its place, which he had prepared for it;
verses.15:4: and likewise the sons of Aaron and the Levites.
verses.15:5: Of the sons of Kohath, Uriel was the chief, and his brothers, one hundred twenty.
verses.15:6: Of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers, two hundred twenty.
verses.15:7: Of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers, one hundred thirty.
verses.15:8: Of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers, two hundred.
verses.15:9: Of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers, eighty.
verses.15:10: Of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers, one hundred twelve.
verses.15:11: And David called Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.15:12: and said to them, "You who are the chiefs of the Levitical families, sanctify yourselves with your brothers and bring the ark of the Lord God of Israel to the place that has been prepared for it,
verses.15:13: so that, just as at the beginning the Lord struck us because you were not present, it may not happen the same way now as well by our doing something unlawful."
verses.15:14: Therefore the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to carry the ark of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.15:15: And the sons of Levi carried the ark of God, just as Moses had commanded according to the word of the Lord, on their shoulders with poles.
verses.15:16: And David told the chiefs of the Levites to appoint singers from their brothers with musical instruments, namely harps, lyres, and cymbals, so that the sound of joy might resound on high.
verses.15:17: And they appointed the Levites: Heman the son of Joel, and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari, their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah.
verses.15:18: And with them their brothers in the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jahiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, and Jehiel, the doorkeepers.
verses.15:19: Now the singers Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were sounding loudly on bronze cymbals.
verses.15:20: And Zechariah, Uzziel, Shemiramoth, Jahiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were singing mysteries on harps.
verses.15:21: Moreover, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jehiel, and Azaziah were singing a song of victory on lyres for the octave.
verses.15:22: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was in charge of prophecy, to lead the melody, for he was very wise.
verses.15:23: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers of the ark.
verses.15:24: Moreover, Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, were sounding trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers of the ark.
verses.15:25: So David, and all the elders of Israel, and the tribunes went to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obed-edom with joy.
verses.15:26: And when God had helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord, seven bulls and seven rams were sacrificed.
verses.15:27: Now David was clothed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah, chief of prophecy among the singers; and David was also clothed in a linen ephod.
verses.15:28: And all Israel was escorting the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting and the sound of the horn, sounding loudly with trumpets, cymbals, harps, and lyres.
verses.15:29: And when the ark of the covenant of the Lord had reached the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul, looking out through a window, saw King David dancing and playing, and she despised him in her heart.
verses.16:1: So they brought the ark of God and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it, and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
verses.16:2: And when David had finished offering the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
verses.16:3: And he distributed to all individually, from man to woman, a loaf of bread, a portion of roasted beef, and fine flour fried in oil.
verses.16:4: And he appointed some of the Levites before the ark of the Lord to minister, and to remember His works, and to glorify and praise the Lord God of Israel:
verses.16:5: Asaph as chief, and second to him Zechariah; furthermore, Jahiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, and Obed-edom; Jehiel over the instruments of the psaltery and lyres; and Asaph to sound aloud with cymbals;
verses.16:6: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests to blow the trumpet continually before the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.16:7: On that day David made Asaph and his brothers chief to give thanks to the Lord:
verses.16:8: "Give thanks to the Lord and call upon His name; make His deeds known among the peoples.
verses.16:9: Sing to Him and sing psalms to Him, and recount all His wonders.
verses.16:10: Praise His holy name; let the heart of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
verses.16:11: Seek the Lord and His power; seek His face always.
verses.16:12: Remember His wonders that He has done, His signs, and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.16:13: seed of Israel, His servant, sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.16:14: He is the Lord our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.16:15: Remember His covenant forever, the word that He commanded for a thousand generations,
verses.16:16: which He made with Abraham, and His oath with Isaac.
verses.16:17: And He established it for Jacob as a statute, and for Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.16:18: saying, 'To you I will give the land of Canaan, the cord of your inheritance,'
verses.16:19: when they were few in number, small and settlers in it.
verses.16:20: And they passed from nation to nation, and from a kingdom to another people.
verses.16:21: He did not allow anyone to oppress them, but He rebuked kings for their sake:
verses.16:22: 'Do not touch My anointed ones, and do no evil against My prophets.'
verses.16:23: Sing to the Lord, all the earth; proclaim His salvation from day to day.
verses.16:25: For the Lord is great and exceedingly worthy of praise, and fearsome above all gods.
verses.16:26: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.16:27: Thanksgiving and magnificence are before Him; strength and joy are in His place.
verses.16:28: Bring to the Lord, families of the peoples; bring to the Lord glory and dominion.
verses.16:29: Give glory to the Lord; lift up a sacrifice to His name, and come into His presence, and worship the Lord in holy beauty.
verses.16:30: Let all the earth be shaken before His face, for He Himself founded the world immovable.
verses.16:31: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth exult, and let them say among the nations, 'The Lord has reigned.'
verses.16:32: Let the sea thunder and its fullness; let the fields exult and all things that are in them.
verses.16:33: Then the trees of the forest will give praise before the Lord, for He is coming to judge the earth.
verses.16:34: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy is forever.
verses.16:35: And say, 'Save us, God our Savior, and gather us and rescue us from the nations, so that we may give thanks to Your holy name and exult in Your songs.'
verses.16:36: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, from eternity to eternity. And let all the people say, 'Amen,' and a hymn to the Lord."
verses.16:37: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord to minister in the presence of the ark continually, each day and in their turns.
verses.16:38: Moreover, he appointed Obed-edom and his sixty-eight brothers, along with Obed-edom the son of Jeduthun and Hosah, as doorkeepers;
verses.16:39: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before the tabernacle of the Lord at the high place that was in Gibeon,
verses.16:40: to offer burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offering continually, morning and evening, according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which He commanded Israel.
verses.16:41: And after him, Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest of the chosen ones, each one by his name, to give thanks to the Lord, for His mercy is forever.
verses.16:42: Heman and Jeduthun also were blowing the trumpet, and striking cymbals and all musical instruments to sing to God; and he made the sons of Jeduthun gatekeepers.
verses.16:43: And all the people returned to their own home, and David, so that he might bless his own household as well.
verses.17:1: Now when David was living in his house, he said to Nathan the prophet, "Look, I live in a cedar house, while the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under skins."
verses.17:2: And Nathan said to David, "Do everything that is in your heart, for God is with you."
verses.17:3: So on that night the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.17:4: "Go and speak to David My servant: 'This is what the Lord says: You will not build a house for Me to live in.
verses.17:5: For I have not remained in a house from the time when I brought Israel out until this day, but I have always been changing the places of the tabernacle, and in a tent
verses.17:6: remaining with all Israel. Have I spoken to even one of the judges of Israel, whom I had commanded to shepherd My people, and said, "Why have you not built a cedar house for Me?"'
verses.17:7: Now therefore, you will speak in this way to My servant David: 'This is what the Lord of hosts says: I took you when you were following the flock in the pastures, so that you might be leader of My people Israel,
verses.17:8: and I have been with you wherever you went, and I have killed all your enemies before you, and I have made for you a name like that of one of the great ones who are celebrated on the earth.
verses.17:9: And I have given a place to My people Israel: it will be planted and will live in it, and will no longer be moved; nor will the sons of iniquity wear them down, as from the beginning,
verses.17:10: from the days in which I gave judges to My people Israel; and I have humbled all your enemies. Therefore I announce to you that the Lord is going to build a house for you.
verses.17:11: And when you have fulfilled your days to go to your fathers, I will raise up your seed after you, who will be from your sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.17:12: He will build a house for Me, and I will make his throne firm forever.
verses.17:13: I will be a father to him, and he will be a son to Me; and I will not take away My mercy from him, as I took it away from the one who was before you.
verses.17:14: And I will set him in My house and in My kingdom forever, and his throne will be most firm for all time.'"
verses.17:15: According to all these words and according to this entire vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
verses.17:16: And when King David had come and sat before the Lord, he said, "Who am I, Lord God, and what is my house, that You would grant me such things?
verses.17:17: Yet even this seemed small in Your sight, and therefore You have spoken concerning the house of Your servant even for the future; and You have made me remarkable above all men, Lord God.
verses.17:18: What more can David add, since You have so glorified Your servant and known him?
verses.17:19: Lord, for the sake of Your servant, according to Your heart, You have done all this greatness, and You have willed all great deeds to be known.
verses.17:20: Lord, there is no one like You, and there is no other god besides You, out of all whom we have heard of with our ears.
verses.17:21: For what other is there like Your people Israel, one nation on the earth, to which God went to free and make a people for Himself, and by His greatness and terrors to drive out nations from before the one whom He had freed from Egypt?
verses.17:22: And You have set Your people Israel as a people for Yourself forever, and You, Lord, have become its God.
verses.17:23: Now therefore, Lord, let the word that You have spoken to Your servant and concerning his house be confirmed forever, and do as You have spoken.
verses.17:24: And let Your name remain and be magnified forever, and let it be said, 'The Lord of hosts is the God of Israel, and the house of David His servant remains before Him.'
verses.17:25: For You, Lord my God, have uncovered the ear of Your servant that You would build a house for him, and for that reason Your servant has found confidence to pray before You.
verses.17:26: Now therefore, Lord, You are God, and You have spoken such great benefits to Your servant.
verses.17:27: And You have begun to bless the house of Your servant, so that it may always be before You; for with You blessing it, Lord, it will be blessed forever."
verses.18:1: Now it happened after these things that David struck the Philistines and humbled them, and took Gath and its daughters from the hand of the Philistines,
verses.18:2: and he struck Moab, and the Moabites became servants of David, offering him gifts.
verses.18:3: At that time David also struck Hadarezer king of Zobah of the region of Hamath, when he went to extend his dominion as far as the river Euphrates.
verses.18:4: Therefore David captured a thousand of his chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand men on foot; and he hamstrung all the chariot horses, except for a hundred chariots, which he reserved for himself.
verses.18:5: Now the Syrians of Damascus also came up to provide help to Hadarezer king of Zobah, yet of them also David struck twenty-two thousand men.
verses.18:6: And he placed soldiers in Damascus, so that Syria also served him and offered gifts. And the Lord helped him in everything to which he had gone.
verses.18:7: David also took the golden quivers that the servants of Hadarezer had possessed, and he brought them to Jerusalem;
verses.18:8: and also from Tibhath and Cun, cities of Hadarezer, very much bronze, from which Solomon made the bronze sea, and the pillars, and the bronze vessels.
verses.18:9: When Tou king of Hamath had heard this, namely, that David had struck the entire army of Hadarezer king of Zobah,
verses.18:10: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to ask him for peace and to congratulate him because he had struck and conquered Hadarezer; for Hadarezer was an adversary of Tou.
verses.18:11: And King David also consecrated all the golden, silver, and bronze vessels to the Lord, along with the silver and gold that he had taken from all the nations, both from Idumea, and Moab, and the sons of Ammon, and from the Philistines and Amalek.
verses.18:12: Now Abishai son of Zeruiah struck Edom in the Valley of Salt Pits, eighteen thousand;
verses.18:13: and he stationed a garrison in Edom, so that Idumea served David; and the Lord saved David in everything to which he had gone.
verses.18:14: Therefore David reigned over all Israel, and he administered judgment and justice for all his people.
verses.18:15: Now Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army, and Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was in charge of the records;
verses.18:16: and Zadok son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech son of Abiathar, were priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.18:17: and Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the legions of the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were first at the hand of the king.
verses.19:1: Now it happened that Nahash king of the sons of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
verses.19:2: And David said, "I will show mercy to Hanun son of Nahash, for his father showed me favor." And David sent messengers to console him over the death of his father. And when they had arrived in the land of the sons of Ammon to console Hanun,
verses.19:3: the princes of the sons of Ammon said to Hanun, "Perhaps you think that David, out of honor for your father, has sent those who would console you, and you do not notice that his servants have come to you to explore, and investigate, and examine your land."
verses.19:4: Therefore Hanun made David's attendants bald and shaved them, and cut off their tunics from the buttocks down to the feet, and sent them away.
verses.19:5: When they had gone away and reported this to David, he sent to meet them (for they had endured a great disgrace) and commanded that they remain in Jericho until their beards grew, and then return.
verses.19:6: Now the sons of Ammon, seeing that they had done an injury to David, both Hanun and the rest of the people, sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Mesopotamia, and from Syria-Maacah, and from Zobah.
verses.19:7: And they hired thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people. When they had come, they encamped opposite Medeba. The sons of Ammon also, gathered from their cities, came to war.
verses.19:8: When David had heard this, he sent Joab and the entire army of mighty men;
verses.19:9: and the sons of Ammon went out and drew up the battle line beside the gate of the city, while the kings who had come to his help stood separately in the field.
verses.19:10: Therefore Joab, realizing that battle was being waged against him in front and at his back, chose the mightiest men from all Israel and marched against the Syrians.
verses.19:11: And the remaining part of the people he placed under the hand of Abishai his brother, and they marched against the sons of Ammon.
verses.19:12: And he said, "If the Syrians overpower me, you will be a help to me; but if the sons of Ammon overcome you, I will be a defense for you.
verses.19:13: Be strong, and let us act like men for our people and for the cities of our God; and the Lord will do what is good in His sight."
verses.19:14: Therefore Joab and the people who were with him marched against the Syrians to battle, and he put them to flight.
verses.19:15: Now the sons of Ammon, seeing that the Syrians had fled, themselves also fled from Abishai his brother and entered the city; and Joab also returned to Jerusalem.
verses.19:16: Now the Syrians, seeing that they had fallen before Israel, sent messengers and brought the Syrians who were across the river; and Shophach, commander of Hadarezer's army, was their leader.
verses.19:17: When this had been reported to David, he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan, and rushed upon them and drew up the battle line opposite them, while they fought against him.
verses.19:18: And the Syrians fled from Israel, and David killed from among the Syrians seven thousand chariots and forty thousand foot soldiers, and Shophach, commander of the army.
verses.19:19: Now the servants of Hadarezer, seeing that they had been overcome by Israel, defected to David and served him; and Syria was no longer willing to provide help to the sons of Ammon.
verses.20:1: Now it happened after the cycle of the year, at that time when kings are accustomed to march out to wars, that Joab gathered the army and the strength of the military force, and laid waste the land of the sons of Ammon; and he marched on and besieged Rabbah. Meanwhile, David was staying in Jerusalem when Joab struck Rabbah and destroyed it.
verses.20:2: And David took the crown of Milcom from his head, and found in it a talent's weight of gold and most precious gems, and from it he made a diadem for himself; he also took very abundant spoils of the city;
verses.20:3: and he brought out the people who were in it, and made threshing sledges, harrows, and iron-shod carts pass over them, so that they were cut in pieces and crushed. Thus David did to all the cities of the sons of Ammon, and he returned with all his people to Jerusalem.
verses.20:4: After these things war broke out in Gezer against the Philistines, in which Sibbecai the Hushathite struck down Sippai, of the lineage of the Rephaim, and humbled them.
verses.20:5: Another war was also waged against the Philistines, in which Adeodatus, the son of Saltus, the Bethlehemite, struck down the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the wooden shaft of whose spear was like a weavers' beam.
